note: Readings, events, summaries and logs before start_date are removed by the updater and hidden by the page. Change the date to keep more or less history. min_load_pct: a thermal unit below this share of its rated capacity is treated as low output (idling); its reported cost per kWh is not used for plant prices. peak_hours: start and end hour of the evening peak used in the frequency statistics. low_reserve_mw: operating reserve below which a reading counts as low reserve.
